identity: A page with text boxes, documents, buttons, or a number spinner for copying, editing, finding, scrolling, signing, and entering text.

scenarios.name: copy-paste
scenarios.screen: One to three titled source boxes contain sentences. The Answer field is empty, and no text is selected or popup is open.
never: The Answer field already contains the requested source text.
A source box starts with its text selected.
A clipboard panel is visible.

arrangements.text: The titled source boxes sit above the Answer field.
The titled source boxes form a column to the left of the Answer field.

scenarios.hint: Show the correctly titled source textbox, or enough boxes for the requested ordinal, containing readable text; empty destination field. A selectable source and pasteable answer are clear.

scenarios.name: copy-paste-2
scenarios.screen: A source box contains a paragraph, a list of lines, or a message with labeled values. An empty text field sits nearby, and no source text is selected.
never: The requested portion is already in the text field.
The source starts with a line or sentence selected.
A separate picker for lines or values is open.

arrangements.text: The source box sits above the empty text field.
The source box sits to the left of the empty text field.
The numbered source lines form a vertical list above the empty text field.

scenarios.hint: Show numbered entries including line 6 and line 5, or a snippet with at least three sentences. Empty answer box. Source line numbers are visually separated from copyable content.

scenarios.name: unicode
scenarios.screen: The task shows either a non-ASCII cue beside an empty text field, a filled source box beside an empty text field, or several labeled items to click. In the button task, no item has been clicked and no Undo control is showing.
never: The text field starts filled with the requested text.
A button task starts with a clicked item or an Undo control.
A character picker or on-screen keyboard is open.

arrangements.text: The cue or source box sits above the empty text field; clickable items form a row in the button task.
The cue or source box sits to the left of the empty text field; clickable items form a column in the button task.

scenarios.hint: Show the exact requested Unicode string or a greeting source with accented text; use fonts that render diacritics correctly. Empty destination field.

scenarios.name: scroll-text
scenarios.screen: A fixed-height scrolling box shows only the first few lines of a longer text, with a scrollbar beside it. Word tasks have an empty answer field; an edge-scrolling task shows the box without an answer field.
never: The box starts at its bottom edge.
A requested line below the fold is already visible.
The answer field starts with the requested word.
All lines are displayed outside the scrolling box.

arrangements.text: The scrolling text box sits above the answer field when a word is requested.
The scrolling text box sits to the left of the answer field when a word is requested.
Line numbers run down the left side of the text inside the scrolling box.

scenarios.hint: Show an internally scrollable numbered text pane with at least 25 lines, visible draggable scrollbar and an empty answer field. Depict the requested target line in view; for end-of-text task bottom is visible. Text has clear final words.

scenarios.name: sign-agreement
scenarios.screen: A fixed-height box shows the beginning of an agreement. The name field is empty, and both Agree and Cancel are disabled until the agreement has been scrolled to the end.
scenarios.scene: The agreement box is scrolled to the end; the name field is blank, Agree and Cancel are enabled, and neither button has been pressed.
never: The name field is enabled at the normal unsolved start.
Agree or Cancel is enabled at the normal unsolved start.
A signed result or Undo control is already showing.
The agreement starts scrolled to its end.

arrangements.text: The agreement box sits above the name field, with Agree and Cancel below the field.
The agreement box sits to the left of the name field, with Agree and Cancel beneath the field.

scenarios.name: spinner
scenarios.screen: A labeled numeric field shows its starting value, with up and down buttons beside it. The field is editable in typing tasks; no button is being held.
never: The field starts at the requested target value.
A button starts pressed or repeating.
A separate number picker or slider is open.

arrangements.text: The label sits above the numeric field, and the up and down buttons sit beside the field.
The label sits to the left of the numeric field, and the up and down buttons sit beside the field.

scenarios.hint: Show the exact requested quantity label and unit, current value different from target, and distinct up/down arrow buttons. Preserve pointer spinner interaction.

scenarios.name: edit
scenarios.screen: One or two labeled text fields contain text that needs a caret insertion, a cut and paste, an undo, or a pasted code. The code task also shows a filled note box; no text is selected at the start.
never: The requested edit is already complete.
A phrase starts selected.
The page's undo history is shown as a visible panel.
A note box appears in tasks that do not use a code.

arrangements.text: The labeled text fields form a vertical stack, with the note box above them when present.
Two text fields sit side by side, with the note box above them when present.
The note box sits to the left of the text field that receives its code.

scenarios.name: find
scenarios.screen: A long document contains several paragraphs, including one occurrence of the requested phrase. Its beginning is visible in a scrolling pane or on the page, and no text is selected.
never: The requested phrase starts selected.
A browser-style search popup is open.
The document starts scrolled to the requested phrase.
A separate results list is visible.

arrangements.text: The paragraphs run vertically inside a scrolling document pane.
The paragraphs run vertically on the page, which scrolls as a whole.
